decision_conditions: <div>The scale, siting and design of the proposed development would result in unacceptable loss of daylight, overshadowing,&nbsp;loss of outlook and overbearing impacts&nbsp;impacts to adjoining properties no.21 and 25 Boyne Road. Therefore, the proposal would constitute unneighbourly development which is contrary to:</div><div><br></div><div><p style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="">- National Planning Policy Framework&nbsp;</span>National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024);<o:p></o:p></p><p style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">- Policy D6 of the London Plan (March 2021);</span><o:p></o:p></p><p style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">- Policies DMD1, DMD5 and DMSI3 of&nbsp;</span>The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024); and</p><p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="line-height: 14.98px;">- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)</span></p></div>

<div><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The first floor&nbsp;rear extension, by reason of its flat roof treatment, would present an&nbsp;incongruous feature that is unsympathetic to the pitched roof of the original dwelling, which would be harmful to the character of the host dwelling.&nbsp;</span>As such, the proposed development is contrary to:<br></div><div><br></div><div><p style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="">- National Planning Policy Framework&nbsp;</span>National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024)<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="line-height: 14.98px;">- Policies D1, D4, D5 and D6 of the London Plan (March 2021)<o:p></o:p></span></p><p style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="">- Policies DMD1, DMD5 and&nbsp;</span>SP2&nbsp;<span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="">of&nbsp;</span>The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</p><p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="line-height: 14.98px;">- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)</span></p></div>
